text: Can you describe the nature of your cough, and do you have any fever or chest pain? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Chest_XRay.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: WBC 9,000 /μL, Hemoglobin 14.0 g/dL, Platelets 230,000 /μL; Chest_X_Ray: Bilateral interstitial infiltrates suggestive of pulmonary fibrosis. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax observed.

speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and do you notice any worsening with exertion? REQUEST TEST: Pulmonary_Function_Tests.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Pulmonary_Function_Tests: Reduced FVC and FEV1 with a normal FEV1/FVC ratio, indicating a restrictive pattern.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any dry, crackling sounds in your chest when you breathe, and do you have a history of asbestos exposure or autoimmune diseases? REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Panel.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis. The combination of bilateral interstitial infiltrates, a restrictive lung pattern on PFTs, and the absence of autoimmune markers or asbestos exposure points to this diagnosis. Do you have any family history of lung disease or connective tissue disorders?
